title: About Vertexx
text: Vertexx designs, integrates and runs automation systems for manufacturers, retailers, energy companies and logistics firms. Founded in 1998 in Jaipur, we have delivered more than 450 projects in 36 countries.

title: How booking works
text: Share your details, choose a product or service, tell us the quantity and your preferred date, and confirm. Our team contacts you within one working day to finalise scope and schedule. A new booking starts as pending and then moves to confirmed, in progress and completed.

title: Pricing
text: Prices shown are starting prices in Indian rupees (lakh) and depend on quantity, number of sites and customisation. The final quotation is shared after a consultation.

title: Timelines and delivery
text: Typical lead times range from 2 weeks for managed operations to 16 weeks for large solution rollouts. Exact dates are confirmed after a site survey.

title: Support and monitoring
text: Managed operations include 24/7 monitoring, monthly tuning and on-call engineers. Our support desk is available Monday to Saturday, 9:30 am to 6:30 pm IST, by phone and email.

title: Certifications
text: Vertexx holds ISO 9001 quality, ISO 14001 environment, ISO 27001 information security and ISO 45001 health and safety certifications.

title: Industries we serve
text: We work with manufacturing, retail, logistics and energy companies.
